GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 5 Lengths Two Wide , Made Some Ground to 4 Lengths 3 Wide turning, Held Up home turn to 200m but couldn't really come on in Straight passing only two tiring runners # never a real threat
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Held up for clear running from home turn until near the 200m. Raced wide throughout.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , Drifted Back 3rd last 10 Lengths 800m, weaved a passage and got widest soon after Straightening Up , Kept Coming under riding last 200m and only Just missed minor placing # big run from back
Little Slow Out Restrained to slot in Settled Down 7th Inside 6 Lengths , off Inside @ 400m 4th x 200m, 3rd x 100m, Closest on line, # Sound Effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the middle stages and near the 800m, was awkwardly placed. Had difficulty obtaining clear running from the 400m until passing the 300m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down Two Wide trailing a half length, Moved Up and edged to the lead at 550m, led Two Wide by a head turning, Headed 200m and weakened to the line # weakened last 200m
Jumped okay & Settled Down 3rd Two Wide trailing just under 2 Lengths , Drifted Back to 3 Lengths Two Wide turning, Lost Ground but held onto 4th place in Straight # Had Every Chance
Slow out 2 Lengths and Settled Down 5 Lengths Four Wide , made no ground to Turn then Made Some Ground in straight. Improvement next start wouldn't surprise. # slow out then Wide
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Approaching the 200m, improved onto heels and shifted in to obtain clear running. Laid in under pressure from this point.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly then made heavy contact for several strides, Settled Down 7.5 Lengths 3 Wide , Made Some Ground to 5 Lengths 3 Wide turning, Dropped Out in straight. [Stewards: Rider reported he had intended racing more forward, however after receiving interference at the start he was obliged to settle further back in the field. He added that, after being caught Wide he restrained to obtain cover, however was forced to race Wide and opined its run was disappointing.] # always Wide
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly & made heavy contact with MEKANIC for several strides. Raced wide throughout. Lost O/H plate in the running. Rdr G Geran reported, his intention was to race more forward, after the interference at the start he was obliged to settle further back in the field. He also added that after being caught wide, he restrained to obtain cover, however was forced to race wide, adding that the mare in his opinion was disappointing.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , led rails 800m, rolled off fence for better ground Straightening Up , Headed at 200m and faded final stages # led/overran 200m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and bumped with BOLE LE. Laid in when under pressure in the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began OK. Not pushed early & raced Mid Field on inside (4L from lead). Stayed same until held up Two Wide @ 450m. Pushed out Five Wide & pressured (3L from lead) on home turn. Pressured 3 Wide @ 250m & stuck on soundly in last 200m. # Every Chance

Jumped okay & Went Forward to joint Lead on fence, Headed 1000m, Drifted Back to 2.5 Lengths rail turning, Held Up home turn then shifted off leader's off heels Straightening Up but could only hold its ground to the line. [Stewards: Raced keenly when crossed.] # Had its chances
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly when crossed near the 700m and shifted out marginally.
